line: Removes 10% of Life Recovered from Mana when used
zero_reason: self_cost_on_use: the cost is Mana paid per flask use (10% of the Life the flask recovers); PoB has no phrase for it and Mana cost per use moves none of the 7 outputs, so it belongs to the self-cost rail
partial_part: Removes 10% of Life Recovered from Mana when used
why: a flask cost in Mana per use is a per-second self-cost (flask uses per second x 10% of Life recovered), read by the self-cost rail not by a PoB output

line: Removes all Energy Shield While not on Full Life, Sacrifice 20% of Mana per Second to Recover that much Life
boss_lane: While not on Full Life, Sacrifice 20% of Mana per Second to Recover that much Life
optimistic_lane: While not on Full Life, Sacrifice 20% of Mana per Second to Recover that much Life
why: PoB's ModParser holds both halves as separate patterns (removes all energy shield; sacrifice N% of mana per second to recover that much life), the comma joins them into one unparsed text

line: You have Sacrifice of Blood if at least 8 Corrupted Items are Equipped
boss_lane: While not on Full Life, Sacrifice 20% of Mana per Second to Recover that much Life
optimistic_lane: While not on Full Life, Sacrifice 20% of Mana per Second to Recover that much Life
